name: Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken
description: Gásakláhko to Vuonatjviken. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Vuonatjviken / Riebnes east boat landing and shuttle (transit)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official STF/Naturkartan distance/time supports a 13 km Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken section and the WFS official-distance split at 66.5839492,17.2754676, while OSM/Wikivoyage/Mapcarta place a Gásakláhko campsite around 66.6202912,17.2744719 and OSM relation 18864494 starts there.
OSM/Waymarked relation 18864494 computes about 16.1 km while tagged/official distance is 13 km. Truncating at WFS split leaves about 11.9 km, closer to official distance.
WFS foot-line end, WFS boat endpoint, Naturkartan GPX endpoint, OSM section join and Vuonatjvikens Stugby service node differ by about 50-215 m.
Official sources confirm accommodation/tenting/restaurant, while route apps mention extra provisions/gas/prices/times. The latter are volatile and not fully official.
Point sampling indicates Hornavan-Sädvajaure reserve/Natura overlap only on the southern/last-kilometers approach; no full polygon overlay was run.
Official Gåbdåk bridge is high confidence, but OSM small bridge and older damaged-bridge field reports are uncertain.
Fire bans, weather, snow/ice, Riebnes boat operations, service opening, hunting/fishing closures and dog/reindeer restrictions are date-sensitive.

facilities.name: Hängbro över Gåbdåk / Bartek bridge
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturvårdsverket Anordningar ID 30325238, SWEREF99 TM 599480.004/7380468.961 converted to WGS84
facilities.description: Official BD78 steel suspension bridge, 32 m long, over Gåbdåk/Bartek. Recheck current bridge condition before relying on it.
facilities.routeProximity: about 6.9 km from provisional start; about 4.1 km before Vuonatjviken GPX endpoint

facilities.name: Vuonatjviken / Vuonatjvikens Stugby
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 1750315974; corroborated by Fjelds of Sweden coordinate and Naturkartan GPX endpoint nearby
facilities.description: Roadless cabin village and service node at section end. STF lists non-STF accommodation where hikers may stay or pitch tents; service site lists cabins, kitchen facilities, sauna, WC/shower/drying facilities and restaurant. Not STF; roadless; booking/opening/payment/current services should be checked before relying on it.

facilities.name: Vuonatjviken tenting at Stugby
facilities.coordinateSource: STF text and Komoot user reports anchored to Vuonatjviken service node
facilities.description: STF says hikers can stay overnight or pitch tents at Vuonatjviken; recent route-app reports mention camping at the rest stop. Confirm current fee/policy directly with Vuonatjviken before standalone campsite import.

facilities.name: Restaurant Nåidde / Vuonatjviken food service
facilities.description: Restaurant at Vuonatjviken; service site says it is open when pre-ordered and accepts cash/cards. STF also notes a restaurant. Not walk-up reliable; pre-order/opening should be verified.

facilities.name: Vuonatjviken / Riebnes east boat landing and shuttle
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM ferry way 163306709 east endpoint; Naturkartan GPX endpoint/service node nearby
facilities.description: Onward Kungsleden connection over Lake Riebnes. STF and Naturkartan say motorboat/private shuttle is required and no rowing boats are available; Vuonatjviken says to contact them to arrange the Riebnes crossing. Operator/contact details have changed across sources. Current STF and Vuonatjviken contact pages list Geir/Sandra; OSM/older reports list Jan/Eva. Schedule, season, weather, booking and payment are date-sensitive.
facilities.routeProximity: section end / start of section-17 connector

source.provider: Naturvårdsverket WFS BD78 split from official stage distances
